canonicalNames: OpenStudyBuilder resource type names, as its proposal target taxonomy names them; the IL ruleset uses the same names from 1.17.0 (formerNames records what 1.16.0 and earlier called three of them)

retired: hand-kept planner, router and read-back tables in CSL
hand-kept capability, family, mapping-context and capture-projection tables in OSB

correspondenceVocabulary.exact: the CSL type and the OSB resource type name the same kind of object
correspondenceVocabulary.broader: the CSL type covers more than the OSB resource type (or the reverse is a selection of it)
correspondenceVocabulary.narrower: the CSL type is one facet of the OSB resource type
correspondenceVocabulary.edge: the OSB resource type is a relationship; CSL states it as a link type
correspondenceVocabulary.property: the OSB resource type is a property of a CSL object, not an object
correspondenceVocabulary.none: no CSL object corresponds; the content is an extension, narrative, pin or unresolved work item

routingVocabulary.study-mutation: a routable study mutation: the claim is searched in its candidate family and executed through cslNativeRoute
routingVocabulary.library: a capture-plane library type: the claim defers until a candidate set resolves it against the OSB library

study_metadata.note: Typed StudyField nodes on the StudyValue; searched through the metadata planner, never a library.

controlled_terminology.note: CTTermRoot with name and attributes versions; candidates are CTTerm contexts inside a codelist.

controlled_terminology_codelists.note: CTCodelistRoot with name and attributes versions.

units.note: UnitDefinitionRoot/Value with UCUM and CT dimension links.

compound_product_relationships.note: Blocker-only: OSB cannot offer a StudyCompound without a compound alias and medicinal product relationship.

study_compound_dosing_relationships.note: Blocker-only: OSB cannot offer a StudyCompoundDosing without the study compound and element.

activity_instruction_templates.note: Syntax templates instantiated into activity instructions.

criteria_templates.note: Syntax templates instantiated into study criteria.

objective_templates.note: Syntax templates instantiated into study objectives.

endpoint_templates.note: Syntax templates instantiated into study endpoints.

timeframes.note: Approved timeframe instances a StudyEndpoint references (never the template).

activities.note: ActivityRoot/Value with groupings; selected into StudyActivity.

odm_forms.note: ODM form definitions; native capture read-back profile.

odm_item_groups.note: ODM item group definitions; native capture read-back profile.

odm_items.note: ODM item definitions; native capture read-back profile.

odm_methods.note: ODM methods: the nearest OSB home for edit checks (semantic mismatch recorded on the OdmMethod row).

odm_conditions.note: ODM conditions: field conditions and branching predicates.

odm_aliases.note: Unversioned OdmAlias nodes searched by name.

activity_schedules.note: StudyActivitySchedule cells (study activity at study visit), unversioned.

cdash_variables.note: DatasetVariable of the CDASH model; requires SDTM and CDASH model/IG selections (collection-model prerequisite).

rows.note: Study metadata fields are properties of Study, StudyDesign and StudyVersion in CSL (STUDY_DESIGN_ATTRIBUTE, STOPPING_RULE and STUDY_ADMINISTRATION_FACT route here); OSB stores one typed StudyField node per configured field.
The CT package pinned for a study; CSL pins terminology per binding (terminology_binding.version) and per release, not as an object.
Blocker-only family: the compound-product relationship must resolve in the library before a native write.
Blocker-only family (USDM dosing normalization required).
Executed by resource type through the study executor, not through a section family.
Timing and window travel as the simple-concept chain on the visit; CSL keeps Timing as an object of its own.
ScheduledActivityInstance (USDM-native) is a second CSL representation of the same schedule cell (R9).
CONDITIONAL_PROCEDURE routes here as a governed extension of Activity; CSL has no instruction object.
A CDASH or SDTM variable is the cdashVariable / sdtmVariable property of a CSL Item and of claim revisions, never an object.
The library item behind StudySelectionActivity.
The concept bridge (plan items A3, A4): derived implements and measures edges keyed by scoped external identifiers; no signed truth.
ENDPOINT_TIMEFRAME is a governed extension of the Endpoint; the timeframe is a property, not an object, in CSL.
EDIT_CHECK routes here and OSB aliases edit_checks to odm_methods, but an ODM Method is a derivation and a CSL ValidationRule is a constraint (F11, R7); ValidationRule has no OSB counterpart.
An OSB relationship between OdmItem and ActivityItem; in CSL the edge is Item measures BiomedicalConcept (and implements).
rows.uiSurface: CRF item to activity binding (integration routes only)

rows.note: CSL link containsGroup (Form to ItemGroup).
rows.uiSurface: CRF structure: form to item group (integration routes only)

rows.note: CSL link containsItem (ItemGroup to Item).
rows.uiSurface: CRF structure: item group to item (integration routes only)

rows.note: MAPS_VARIABLE_CLASS and HAS_VALID_CODELIST_FOR_ITEMS are the dataset-specialization half of a CSL concept binding.
The study's selection of a library ActivityInstance; CSL scopes a concept to the study by identity, not by a selection object.
Governed extension payloads (14 rules); they stay properties of the CSL object they extend.
Verbatim sentences are retained as claims in CSL; NarrativeContent only when a definition must reference a text as a whole.
Content OSB could not route; a retained work item in CSL.
